title: 'Magaling na lider, mabuting tao': Dingdong Dantes remembers late Quirino governor Dax Cua
summary: Actor Dingdong Dantes on Thursday paid tribute to the late Quirino Governor Dakila 'Dax' Cua, remembering him as a great leader and a good person.
